info.title: LLM Foundations Local Companion API
info.description: Normative local-only API target. No implementation or qualification claim.

delete.description: Invalidates the bearer access token and CSRF token of the calling session immediately; later requests with them return 401 AUTH_REQUIRED.

get.summary: List artifacts, newest last, optionally by creating job and type

post.summary: Abandon an attempt whose token was never used (for example a lost token)
Append an exercise record; server derives feedback_opened_early, revised_after_job_start and progress flags

get.summary: List exercise records (assessor history), oldest first

field_path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the request body (multipart: /<part>/<line>/<field>); empty string for whole-request errors.

max_active_previews.description: Active import and deletion previews (not context previews).

queue_position.description: 1-based FIFO position among queued jobs; null unless state is queued.

hold_deadline_at.description: started time of the cancellable_hold phase plus 600 seconds; null outside the hold.

score.description: Unrounded binary64 cosine; may exceed 1 by rounding (a document queried with its own text scores 1.0000000000000002 in retrieval-corpus-v1); never clamped.

ReasonCode.description: Closed reason code vocabulary generated from contracts/error-vocabulary.json.

JobErrorCode.description: Closed job code vocabulary generated from contracts/error-vocabulary.json.

TerminalReason.description: Closed terminal code vocabulary generated from contracts/error-vocabulary.json.

CudaPreflight.description: RUN-015 CUDA preflight result; null on CPU profiles.

GpuQueryLine.description: One parsed line of the RUN-015 GPU query.

GpuOffer.description: RUN-001 GPU offer, computed at startup and by gpu-check; never persisted.
